detaileddescription.para: Returns true if ptr is in the range [begin(), end()). Be aware that this implies that the return value is true when ptr is null and the block is a null.
Returns the number of bytes in the range [begin(), end()).
Returns the number of bytes in the range [position(), end()).
Returns the number of bytes in the range [begin(), position()).
Returns true if previousBlock() is not null.
Returns true this is a null block object. That is, if begin(), end() and position() are all null.

briefdescription.para: Moves ownership of memory and leaves block in a valid null state.
Makes this a null block object. Does NOT free the owned memory!

detaileddescription.para: Frees the memory for this block.
Frees the memory for the previous block.
Makes new memory for this block and puts the old memory in a block previous to this block.

A block owns a range of memory [begin(), end()) and keeps track of a position within the range [begin(), end()] given by position(). It is possible for a block to own no memory, in which case begin(), end() and position are null - we call this a null block object. Do not create your own blocks - their lifetime is handled by MemoryBlocks.
